item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in .agent-input/product-build/SKILL.md .agent-input/product-management/SKILL.md .agent-input/systems-architecture/SKILL.md .agent-input/frontend/SKILL.md .agent-input/backend-engineering/SKILL.md .agent-input/product-acceptance/SKILL.md; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in .agent-input/product-build/SKILL.md .agent-input/product-management/SKILL.md .agent-input/systems-architecture/SKILL.md .agent-input/frontend/SKILL.md .agent-input/backend-engineering/SKILL.md .agent-input/product-acceptance/SKILL.md; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' package.json; echo '--- src/server.js'; sed -n '1,300p' src/server.js; echo '--- public/index.html'; sed -n '1,300p' public/index.html; echo '--- tests'; sed -n '1,320p' test/server.test.js; echo '--- README'; sed -n '1,240p' README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' package.json; echo '--- src/server.js'; sed -n '1,300p' src/server.js; echo '--- public/index.html'; sed -n '1,300p' public/index.html; echo '--- tests'; sed -n '1,320p' test/server.test.js; echo '--- README'; sed -n '1,240p' README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "find .agent-input -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort; echo '--- relevant refs'; for f in .agent-input/systems-architecture/references/boundaries.md .agent-input/frontend/references/design-principles.md .agent-input/frontend/references/ux-states.md .agent-input/backend-engineering/references/server-laws.md .agent-input/product-acceptance/references/adversarial-checklist.md; do test -f \""'$f" && { echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,220p' \""'$f"; }; done'

/bin/bash -lc "find .agent-input -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort; echo '--- relevant refs'; for f in .agent-input/systems-architecture/references/boundaries.md .agent-input/frontend/references/design-principles.md .agent-input/frontend/references/ux-states.md .agent-input/backend-engineering/references/server-laws.md .agent-input/product-acceptance/references/adversarial-checklist.md; do test -f \""'$f" && { echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,220p' \""'$f"; }; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'tmpdir=$(mktemp -d); for pair in architecture systems-architecture frontend frontend backend-engineering backend-engineering product-acceptance product-acceptance; do :; done; mkdir -p "$tmpdir"; cp .agent-input/systems-architecture/scripts/check-architecture.js "$tmpdir/arch.cjs"; cp .agent-input/systems-architecture/scripts/resolve-core.cjs "$tmpdir/resolve-core.cjs"; node "$tmpdir/arch.cjs" --root . --strict; cp .agent-input/frontend/scripts/check-frontend.js "$tmpdir/front.cjs"; cp .agent-input/frontend/scripts/resolve-core.cjs "$tmpdir/resolve-core.cjs"; node "$tmpdir/front.cjs" --root . --strict; cp .agent-input/backend-engineering/scripts/check-backend.js "$tmpdir/back.cjs"; cp .agent-input/backend-engineering/scripts/resolve-core.cjs "$tmpdir/resolve-core.cjs"; node "$tmpdir/back.cjs" --root . --strict; cp .agent-input/product-acceptance/scripts/accept-check.js "$tmpdir/accept.cjs"; cp .agent-input/product-acceptance/scripts/resolve-core.cjs "$tmpdir/resolve-core.cjs"; node "$tmpdir/accept.cjs" --root . --strict'

/bin/bash -lc 'tmpdir=$(mktemp -d); for pair in architecture systems-architecture frontend frontend backend-engineering backend-engineering product-acceptance product-acceptance; do :; done; mkdir -p "$tmpdir"; cp .agent-input/systems-architecture/scripts/check-architecture.js "$tmpdir/arch.cjs"; cp .agent-input/systems-architecture/scripts/resolve-core.cjs "$tmpdir/resolve-core.cjs"; node "$tmpdir/arch.cjs" --root . --strict; cp .agent-input/frontend/scripts/check-frontend.js "$tmpdir/front.cjs"; cp .agent-input/frontend/scripts/resolve-core.cjs "$tmpdir/resolve-core.cjs"; node "$tmpdir/front.cjs" --root . --strict; cp .agent-input/backend-engineering/scripts/check-backend.js "$tmpdir/back.cjs"; cp .agent-input/backend-engineering/scripts/resolve-core.cjs "$tmpdir/resolve-core.cjs"; node "$tmpdir/back.cjs" --root . --strict; cp .agent-input/product-acceptance/scripts/accept-check.js "$tmpdir/accept.cjs"; cp .agent-input/product-acceptance/scripts/resolve-core.cjs "$tmpdir/resolve-core.cjs"; node "$tmpdir/accept.cjs" --root . --strict'

/bin/bash -lc 'node src/server.js > /tmp/project-invites.log 2>&1 & server_pid=$!; trap '"'kill "'$server_pid 2>/dev/null || true'"' EXIT; sleep 0.2; first="'$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/projects/roadmap/invites -H '"'Authorization: Bearer admin.account' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: workflow-1' --data '{\"email\":\"person@example.com\",\"role\":\"viewer\"}'); second="'$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/projects/roadmap/invites -H '"'Authorization: Bearer admin.account' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: workflow-1' --data '{\"email\":\"other@example.com\",\"role\":\"editor\"}'); echo \"first="'$first"; echo "second=$second"; test "$first" = "$second"; curl -sS -o /tmp/invalid-response -w '"'invalid_status=%{http_code}\\n' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/projects/roadmap/invites -H 'Authorization: Bearer admin.account' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: workflow-2' --data '{\"email\":\"bad\",\"role\":\"viewer\"}'; cat /tmp/invalid-response"

/bin/bash -lc 'node src/server.js > /tmp/project-invites.log 2>&1 & server_pid=$!; trap '"'kill "'$server_pid 2>/dev/null || true'"' EXIT; sleep 0.2; first="'$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/projects/roadmap/invites -H '"'Authorization: Bearer admin.account' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: workflow-1' --data '{\"email\":\"person@example.com\",\"role\":\"viewer\"}'); second="'$(curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/projects/roadmap/invites -H '"'Authorization: Bearer admin.account' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: workflow-1' --data '{\"email\":\"other@example.com\",\"role\":\"editor\"}'); echo \"first="'$first"; echo "second=$second"; test "$first" = "$second"; curl -sS -o /tmp/invalid-response -w '"'invalid_status=%{http_code}\\n' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/projects/roadmap/invites -H 'Authorization: Bearer admin.account' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: workflow-2' --data '{\"email\":\"bad\",\"role\":\"viewer\"}'; cat /tmp/invalid-response"
